brief: The market's stock is a switch where it should be a gradient: `shelved` is capped at exactly the open boards' capacity, so a board is either full or the day is bare and a half-stocked pitch is unreachable (c287, raised at #192, unanswered for 13 iterations). Lane & market is the longest-untouched domain, 12 back. PRICE THE PREMISE FIRST: histogram `shelved` against `mkOpenCount()*MK_GOODS` over 6 seeds x a year and count the days that sit at the cap — if the cap never binds, or the SUPPLY is the real bound, say so and make the measurement the deliverable. If it does bind, make the fill something the day spends: stocked up by mid-morning, thinned by late afternoon, out of the supply the allotments' cart actually delivered.
successLooksLike: On a market day the boards are visibly fuller at mid-morning than at four o'clock, in the Street quarter, without needing a difference image to see it.
avoid: Do not add a stall type and do not raise MK_CAP — #193 already re-sized the market and LAWS says a cap and a rate are two bounds, only one of which can be swept.
